title: Reportadmin
description: Reportadmin is an advanced Velocity moderation plugin that allows players to send reports and help requests directly from the server, featuring Discord webhook integration, interactive staff notifications, smart auto-completion, and multi-server support.
body:
# Reportadmin

Reportadmin is an advanced plugin for Velocity and Paper designed to improve moderation and player assistance using a modern report and help-request system fully connected with Discord.

Thanks to Discord integration, staff members can receive reports and help requests even when they are not connected to the server, allowing them to quickly join and handle problems, assist players, or moderate situations in real time.

---

## Features

### Report System

Players can report users easily using:

`/report <player> <reason>`

Features include:

- Online player verification
- Name auto-completion
- Automatic reason suggestions
- Professional staff notifications
- Discord webhook integration
- Server information included in reports

---

### Help Request System

Players can request staff help using:

`/ayuda <reason>`

Perfect for:

- Reporting bugs
- Requesting assistance
- Rank problems
- Questions about rules
- General support

---

### Interactive Staff Notifications

When a player sends a report or help request:

- Staff receive clean in-game notifications
- Screen titles are displayed
- Clickable buttons allow staff to join the player's server
- Multi-server/proxy support
- Compatible with both Velocity and Paper servers

---

### Discord Integration

The plugin automatically sends reports and help requests to Discord using professional embeds:

- Colored embeds
- Automatic titles
- Organized information
- Compatible with any Discord webhook

---

### Smart Auto-Completion

Automatic suggestions for:

- Online player names
- Common report reasons
- Quick help-request phrases
- Administrative subcommands

---

### Reload System

Administrators can reload the configuration without restarting the server or proxy:

`/reportadmin reload`

---

## Commands

### Players

- `/report <player> <reason>`
- `/ayuda <reason>`

### Administrators

- `/reportadmin reload`

---

## Permissions

- `report.admin`  
  Allows staff notifications and administrative commands.

---

## Compatibility

- Velocity Proxy
- Paper
- Java 17+

---

## Configuration

The plugin automatically generates:

`plugins/Reportadmin/config.yml`

You only need to add your Discord webhook.

Example:

```yaml
webhook: "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123456789/TestWebhook"
